bias.en: Uptrend · above the Oct 27 high, 30-day next
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 站上 10月27日高点，下一关 30 日均线

read.en: TSMC rose 0.6% on Oct 28 to $439.51, trading between $436.84 and $440.88 on light volume. It is above the rising 5-day ($426.3), falling 10-day ($424.4), falling 100-day ($429.8) and rising 200-day ($399.3) averages, and below the rising 30-day ($444.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9, below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 27 ($407.76), and RSI is 52.
read.zh: 台积电 10月28日上涨 0.6%，收于 $439.51，盘中区间 $436.84–440.88，成交清淡。股价位于上行的 5 日（$426.3）、下行的 10 日（$424.4）、下行的 100 日（$429.8）和上行的 200 日均线（$399.3）上方，低于上行的 30 日均线（$444.1）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄并接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月27日起看多（$407.76），RSI 为 52。

read.en: The close edged above the $438.6 Oct 27 high, now support. Resistance is $440.9 (Oct 28 high), then $444.1–445.5 (30-day, Oct 13 high) and $454.4 (Oct 12 high). Support is $436.8–438.6 (Oct 28 low, Oct 27 high), then $428.9–429.8 (100-day, Oct 26 high) and $424.4–426.3 (10 and 5-day). A close above $445.5 would target $454; below $436.8, $429.
